parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en:
The owner type. Valid values:
user: the personal memory of the authenticated user.
group: the memory of a specified workspace
parameters.help_zh: user 为鉴权用户的个人记忆；group 为指定协作空间记忆
parameters.name: owner_type

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. This parameter is required when ownerType is set to group
parameters.help_zh: 协作空间 ID；ownerType 为 group 时必填
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The memory type. Valid values: user, feedback, reference, project, and all. A value of all does not clear manual memory
parameters.help_zh: user、feedback、reference、project 或 all；all 不清空手动记忆
parameters.name: type

clearedCount.description_en: The number of automatic memory files successfully deleted in this request. The value is 0 if no memory is available to be cleared
clearedCount.description_zh: 本次成功删除的自动记忆文件数量；无可清空记忆时为 0

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

message.example: 当前用户不是群组 cg_12345 的活跃成员

type.description_en: The type of automatic memory cleared in this request. Valid values: user, feedback, reference, project, and all
type.description_zh: 本次清空的自动记忆类型；取值为 user、feedback、reference、project 或 all
